name: Ways
effect: Moves and carries. Travels 10×E metres, carrying anything it touches (up to 50×E kg) and bouncing off anything heavier. A strike bolt carries an object as a projectile for E/2 DC — to the target *and* the projectile.
infused: You can beckon an object of up to E kg to your hand (one at a time), arriving at E/mass metres per second. An infused object becomes a magnet for anything under √E kg.

name: Image
effect: A projection that looks, sounds and smells exactly like something — but only travels in a straight line or stands still. It discharges in a puff and a sizzle when a sentient being touches it.
infused: Changes the target's appearance instead, and does not discharge on touch.

name: Glass
effect: Transparent. Anything it intersects becomes transparent too.
infused: The target turns transparent — not invisible (there's visible distortion), but −4 to aim missiles at, and −3 for anyone trying to notice or locate them by sight.

name: Fire
forms: orb, ball, strike bolt, barrier, infusion
effect: Discharges into anything that touches it. The weaver chooses how many discharges N; each does E/N DC, and the last one ends the projection. Radiates enough heat to be unpleasant to approach.
infused: You can breathe fire as an action (a missile attack rolled on Perception) at E metres for E/2 DC. You're hot to touch (DC 1, or DC 5 per 3s sustained), and flammable things you touch catch alight. Careful: two people in contact both get infused at half energy.

name: Healing
effect: Puts whoever it strikes into a healing sleep for its duration, during which they make recovery rolls as though a day passed every five seconds — and QR10 results (which would normally worsen them) are ignored. It works as an offensive spell, the drawback being that you heal the victim. A conscious target can resist by willpower at +1−√E.
infused: A recovery roll every three seconds while injured, ignoring QR10.

name: Water
forms: orb, ball, strike bolt, barrier, infusion
effect: Subtracts twice its energy from any fire projection it contacts, discharging itself in the process, and douses ordinary fire (losing 1 energy per square metre extinguished).
infused: Reduces the DC of any fire damage the target takes by E, without discharging. Powerful defensively and superb against ordinary fires — useless offensively.

name: Smoke
forms: orb, ball, strike bolt, barrier, infusion
effect: Discharges on contact and wreathes the target in a personal smoke cloud: −√E to anything needing hand–eye coordination. As a barrier it does the same to actions taken through it.

name: Bamboo
effect: Discharges into the ground and grows a thicket √E metres across and √E metres high. Anyone standing where it grows is likely tangled in it, and it's hard going for everyone else.

name: Metal
forms: orb, ball, strike bolt, barrier, infusion
effect: A swarm of fast darts. An orb is E darts at DC 2; a ball is E/2 darts at DC 4; a strike bolt is a single bolt at E×1.5 (armour protects normally). A barrier is a wall of metal.
infused: The object takes on metal's properties.

name: Stone
effect: Turns the target to stone — much heavier, and impossible to damage.
infused: You cannot be damaged while you stay perfectly still (and you needn't breathe while you do).

name: Snake
effect: Entangles what it strikes in animated tendrils of effective strength E×2. If something else touches the entangled object, the snake spreads out and divides its strength between them.

name: Rat
effect: Bursts into a swarm of nasty little rodents that swarm over the target. They last for the duration, doing √E × DC 1 in any ten-second period the victim spends *not* concentrating on getting rid of them. A strike bolt causes disease.

name: Sun
effect: Intensely bright — an object struck glows and is at least partly blinded, especially to anything not close enough to be brightly lit. Puts out light equivalent to E × 60-watt globes, visible a very long way in the dark.

name: Moon
effect: Deflects other orbs, balls and strike bolts of energy equal to or less than its own. A moving person or object it strikes is flung back √E metres at their previous forward speed; stationary things don't interact with it at all.
